resources.string: One Touch Guard app, two modes in Settings: Full Screen Lock blocks every screen touch. Lock with Social Access allows recognized high-fives, leaderboard scrolling, and song hearts while other controls stay blocked. Hold Volume Down for five seconds to turn protection on or off. Social mode reads Peloton control identities, positions, and high-five wording locally during protected gestures. No screen data is saved or uploaded. Full Screen Lock does not inspect screen content. No internet permission.
